name: MenuButton
summary: A button that opens a short menu of actions or starting points, such as presets. One trigger, one list, nested once. Not for a value that stays chosen and shows in the control (use Select or SegmentedControl), for navigation (use Navigation or Link), or for one action (use Button). Added for the Colour page's brand presets (owner, F7d, 2026-11-07).
a11y: The WAI-ARIA APG menu button: a native `button` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`, controlling a `role="menu"` of `menuitem` ListItems named by `menuLabel`. Opening moves focus into the menu; choosing, Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the button; Tab closes it and moves on. The menu opens in the top layer (the shared popup rule: under the button, flipping above near the window's end, never clipped) and its items are the one ListItem every popup list uses. A 44 px target from `normal` (36 px at `s`, 24 px at `xs`, dense exceptions). Busy keeps the same focused trigger, locked with `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy`, its present-tense label as the name, and the width of its widest label. Icon-only is named by `label`, also its tooltip; each item is at least 44 px tall. Previews are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's words: what the menu offers, e.g. "Presets".

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon from the active set.

props.name: flag
props.description: A country's flag before the words, e.g. the chosen dialling code's. Decorative.

props.name: items
props.description: The actions or choices, in a meaningful order.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: The chosen item. The menu closes and focus returns to the button.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: The menu's accessible name when it differs from `label`, e.g. "Brand colour presets".

props.name: size
props.description: The Button size scale: `normal` (44 px) by default; `s` (36 px) on dense surfaces (O41); xs 24 to xxl 80 px.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The menu can't open here. Prefer saying why nearby.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: As Button: `default` outlined, `primary` for the one main action in a view (a split button's menu half matches its action), `quiet` in toolbars.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Shows only the icon (`chevron-down` when none is given); `label` becomes its accessible name and tooltip. Square at every size; the menu half of a split button.

props.name: tone
props.description: `inherit`: a quiet trigger takes its surroundings' text colour, as Button's `tone`, on a coloured rail or toolbar.

props.name: busy
props.description: Something the menu started is still running (applying a preset, exporting): a spinner takes the icon's place, the menu won't open and presses are ignored until false.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: Present tense while `busy`, e.g. "Applying…"; the label stays when left out.

props.name: listWidth
props.description: Pins the menu to one width step (Q130, docs/widths.md). Leave out to fit the items, snapped up to `xs`, `sm` or `md`. Pin only so menus that sit together (one toolbar) match, or when the items change while it's open.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, matching Popover; omit for uncontrolled behaviour.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu asks to open or close in controlled mode.

props.name: value
props.description: What `onSelect` receives.

props.name: label
props.description: The item's name, in sentence case.

props.name: description
props.description: One short line under the name: what choosing it does or gives.
